verdict.rationale: Paddle's own docs say it publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the Billing API that users can download. The spec is kept in the documented github.com/PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi repo (v1/openapi.yaml), and an importable Postman collection is also offered. The probe 404s were only at guessed undocumented paths, so they do not contradict the documented location. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the documented download works, and no spec served at a well-known docs-site path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Paddle publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the Paddle Billing API.
Download the Paddle OpenAPI specification to generate client libraries, power editor tooling, or import into API exploration tools
The Paddle Postman collection includes every operation, so you can try the API interactively before writing code.
